subject: Private deployment demo — coordinating EU DPO & APAC security reviewer windows
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@helixbiotech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Chen <s.chen@helixbiotech.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@procureline.io>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment demo — need EU DPO + APAC security reviewer present

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We are ready to move to a private deployment deep-dive with our security and legal stakeholders. The ask from procurement is that the EU DPO and an APAC security reviewer are on the call (they need to sign off on data residency + key management sections).

Availability constraints on our side: the Helix security team in EU can do mornings CET (08:30–11:30 CET) and APAC reviewers are only available late evenings SGT (20:00–23:00 SGT) because they are in different timezones and have a maintenance window mid-day. We realise this is not ideal. Also worth flagging: some of our EU reviewers are traveling May 20–22 which affects availability.

Proposed windows we can cover (we included conversions):
- Tue May 18, 09:30–10:30 CET / Mon May 17 23:30–00:30 EDT (late US) — EU morning, APAC not available
- Wed May 19, 20:30–21:30 SGT / Wed May 19 08:30–09:30 CET / Tue May 18 23:30–00:30 PDT — possible if Redwood can do an overnight slot for US folks

If none of those work, would appreciate a couple of alternate windows from your side that align morning CET + late SGT simultaneously. We understand daylight savings edges might complicate conversions this month.

Attaching a short doc with the items the reviewers want to see in the demo.

Jordan
Director, IT Security — Helix Biotech
Attachments: security-request-list.pdf (1 page stub)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@helixbiotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — need EU DPO + APAC security reviewer present

Thanks Jordan — good, concrete constraints. We can absolutely support a cross-zone window; will need the DPO and APAC lead to sign off on the agenda items you attached.

Internally looping in Kimberly (our EU compliance liaison) and Vivek (APAC security lead) to confirm availability. Marissa from Sales will help coordinate timings and get a mutual action plan scheduled in HubSpot.

Two asks from our side before we lock a slot:
- Can you confirm whether the reviewers need live access to a private cluster or screenshots/recorded flows will suffice for the first review?
- Any non-disclosure paperwork we should have in place before a private demo for EU reviewers?

Quick proposal from Redwood that might work across the three zones (we converted to local times):
Option A: Wed May 19 — 08:30–09:30 CET | 23:30–00:30 PDT (Tue night US) | 20:30–21:30 SGT (APAC) — aligns with your Wed suggestion
Option B: Thu May 20 — 07:00–08:00 CET | 22:00–23:00 PDT (Wed night US) | 19:00–20:00 SGT — slightly earlier EU window but still morning

I’ll let Kimberly/Vivek confirm. If either option looks impossible, shoot 2–3 alternate windows and we’ll triage.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 01:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — need EU DPO + APAC security reviewer present

Eve —

I can join either Option A or B but with a constraint: I must have the data flow diagrams and KMS scope at least 48 hours ahead for DPO review. The DPO team prefers morning CET (08:30–10:30 CET) and will not accept a 07:00 CET slot unless pre-approval is granted. Also note: the DPO team has a regional holiday on May 21 which limits late-week availability.

If needed, I can be present on Option A (Wed May 19 08:30 CET). Please circulate the draft agenda and KMS diagram by end of day Monday (May 17 CET) for DPO pre-read.

Kimberly
Compliance Lead (EU) — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 07:24:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — need EU DPO + APAC security reviewer present

Evelyn / Marissa —

I can make Option A (Wed May 19 20:30 SGT) but only if we keep the session to 60 minutes and stick to the reviewer checklist—no extended Q&A beyond 20 minutes. Our APAC reviewers have a maintenance blackout on May 20 local time, so Thursday is harder. Also: overnight US times are usually fine, but please avoid scheduling frequently during their 22:00–02:00 window more than once in a quarter.

I’ll prepare the APAC checklist and can provide an export of the audit log sample for the demo (sanitised). Would be helpful to know whether Helix needs live cluster access; if not, we can do a recorded walkthrough plus live Q&A.

—Vivek
APAC Security — Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@helixbiotech.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <s.chen@helixbiotech.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@procureline.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:05:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — need EU DPO + APAC security reviewer present

Jordan / Sarah / Olivia —

Thanks — we have a path forward. Final proposed slot: Option A — Wed May 19, 08:30–09:30 CET (Wed May 19, 20:30–21:30 SGT / Tue May 18 23:30–00:30 PDT).

What we’ll do for the reviewers:
- 0–5 min: Introductions and scope (Evelyn)
- 5–25 min: Architecture & data flow with KMS scope (Kimberly) — DPO pre-read will be circulated by Monday EOD CET
- 25–45 min: Demo of private cluster (screenshare, not live prod access) and audit log export (Vivek)
- 45–60 min: Q&A and next steps; sign-off checklist review (Marissa)

Action items:
- Helix: confirm that screenshots + live demo (no live cluster credentials) are sufficient for the first review (Jordan / Sarah) — reply please by EOD Monday 17 May CET.
- Redwood: circulate Agenda-Private-deploy-demo.pdf and Security-Reviewer-Checklist.xlsx (attached) by EOD Monday May 17 CET — Kimberly to include KMS scope and Vivek will attach a sanitized audit log sample.
- Marissa: please create the HubSpot mutual action plan and DocuSign checklist link (we’ll include the DPO signature step).

If Helix needs live access during this first session we may need to carve out an additional follow-up window for secure hands-on access; please confirm.

Thanks everyone — I’ll schedule the calendar invite after Helix confirms the screenshots/live-demo ask.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Agenda-Private-deploy-demo.pdf; Security-Reviewer-Checklist.xlsx
